dependencies: Central serial JUnit/asset audit -> related GameTest -> full regression/build

checks: Original/output source hashes and declared transformations
Ogg decode/mono/peak/clipped samples and event references after assets exist
Preserve existing exact-victim, damage, ammo, radius, cover, attribution and nonrecursive assertions

capability.rule: Topmaster inspects advertised native capabilities before input. Unsupported slot selection, Q or Ctrl+Q remains not_run_capability; never substitute server commands as native input success.

setup.loadoutPreparation: Server fixture may prepare exact original stack, selected perk and finite paid ammunition. Fixture commands are preparation only. Record source/JAR/server pack/client cached pack pins before any run.
setup.environment: Spawn-disabled fixed arena; record every corridor entity UUID/species/position/AABB, team, cover, HP/absorption, original loadout/stack, owned observers/reservations/projectiles/HUD/session. Exact primary victim plus open neighbor inside radius, covered neighbor, and neighbor outside radius. Unexpected corridor entity is a preserved failure/diagnostic.
controls: precision final blow with Dragonfly selected
secondary explosion causing a neighbor death must not recursively dispatch

inputSteps: Only after source identity acceptance, runtime integration, central serial gates and fixed candidate: acquire input lease.
With verified advertised capabilities, apply bounded native aim/ADS/use for a paid precision final blow; retain receipt and exact server victim evidence.
Run nonlethal/body/no-perk and obstruction/radius controls serially with teardown and fixture recreation between cases. Preserve original target/damage/ammo assertions.
Finally release; verify input and server state neutrality before continuing.
serverOracle: Exact victim/paid ammunition/positive HP or absorption reduction and actual final blow; one dedicated element event at corpse bounding-box center only for selected-perk precision kill.
Record actual event key, single dispatch, actual recipients/dimension/distance and open-neighbor HP; covered/outside neighbors unchanged.
No Dragonfly dispatch for body, nonlethal or no-perk controls; no recursive dispatch on secondary damage.
Existing radius/falloff/cover/attribution semantics remain as specified by W77; cosmetic failure must not cancel damage.
framePlan: Fresh actual PNG for each element and control: before/impact/restored, bracketed by native and server state.
Record shader/FOV and source/JAR/pack pins. Bracketed states are not exact tick/frame synchronization; never reuse another candidate PNG.
scenarios.audioClaim: 청감 미검증. No capture or listening performed in this research. Server event/packet/receipt/OpenAL/PNG cannot establish audible Dragonfly identity or mix. A later explicit actual audio capture/listening review must separately establish identity, timing and spatial mix.
scenarios.cleanup: Topmaster owns the single QA server/profile/world/client. Acquire the scenario input lease, bound every sequence, and finally release that lease. Verify lease/heldKeys/pendingSteps/nativeInput neutral plus server use/ADS/camera/session restoration. Track and idempotently clean only run-owned target UUIDs, observers, teams, reservations, projectiles and HUD/session state on success/failure/timeout/cancel. Restore original state; confirm teardown before next scenario. Never delete unexpected entities to make a test pass, release physical user keys wholesale, or close another owner process. If release is only ACKed without neutral-state confirmation, fail/unknown and stop subsequent inputs.
